provider_help: Select the AI engine used for media analysis and tag generation. Ollama is standard for local operation.
language_help: Switch application interface language between Japanese and English.
label_ffmpeg_notice: Show notice when FFmpeg is not installed
ffmpeg_notice_help: Toggle notice icon when FFmpeg (required for video processing) is missing.
ollama_url_help: Connection URL for running Ollama server instance (default: http://localhost:11434).
vlm_model_help: Vision model responsible for analyzing image content and video frames (e.g. minicpm-v, llama3.2-vision).
label_show_non_vision_models: Show models without a vision capability
no_vision_models: No model declares a vision capability. Tick the box below to also choose models without one.
vision_filter_note: Vision support is judged by what Ollama declares. A declaration does not guarantee that analysis will be reliable.
force_detailed_help: Forcing detailed mode on smaller models (<8B) may cause parsing errors if the model fails complex JSON formatting. Recommended OFF (auto-falls back to LIGHT mode on failure).
text_model_help: Language model for structured tag extraction & Japanese/English tag translation from VLM output (e.g. qwen2.5, llama3.1).
unload_vram_help: Instantly unloads loaded Ollama models from GPU VRAM. Model will be purged even if used by other WebUI or applications.
ollama_not_installed: Ollama is not installed or service is not running. Please start or install Ollama to use local VLM features.
ollama_num_ctx_help: 0 = auto (8192-16384 depending on tag granularity). Thinking models such as qwen3-vl spend a large number of reasoning tokens before emitting the answer, so an undersized context truncates generation and returns an empty response, causing frequent retries. The context is automatically doubled when it runs out.
ollama_max_image_edge_help: Downscales images to this longest edge before analysis (0 to disable). The aspect ratio is preserved. A 12MP photo alone costs about 4000 tokens, so downscaling frees up context and speeds up analysis. Raise this value if OCR accuracy matters more.
llm_debug_logging_help: Logs prompt style, num_ctx, token usage and done_reason for each request, plus the raw response when analysis fails. Use it to investigate retries. Keep it OFF normally as it increases log volume.
tag_granularity_help: Controls how much tags are decomposed when using the DETAILED prompt. Basic tags always stay at 5-10, while descriptive tags (e.g. "rain_soaked_tree") are added based on the granularity level.
granularity_disabled_light: The current model uses the LIGHT prompt, so tag granularity does not apply. Open "Advanced settings" below and enable "Force Detailed Prompt" to use this setting.
granularity_changed_notice: Tag granularity changed. The new setting only applies to media analyzed from now on. To align tags on existing media, re-analyze them from Folder Management.
spectrum_help: Vectorizes tag meanings so you can find semantically related media even when tags do not match exactly. Vectorization is run manually and does not affect scanning.
spectrum_model_missing: This model is not installed in Ollama. Install it from the cards above.
spectrum_centering_help: When off, media with many tags tend to look similar to everything.
spectrum_descriptive_help: When on, media analyzed with a high-accuracy model may preferentially match each other.
label_spectrum_hub_corr: Correlation: tag count vs mean similarity
label_spectrum_gc: Delete vectors for models not in use
item_spectrum_switch_kept: Vectors for the previous model are kept — switching back restores them instantly
diag_separation_ok: Larger is better — similar and dissimilar are clearly separated. A small value means everything looks alike.
diag_separation_warn: The distribution is narrow, so nothing can be told apart. Check that centering is ON and try a more capable embedding model.
diag_hub_ok: Closer to 0 is better. Media with many tags are not matching everything.
diag_hub_warn: Media with many tags match everything. Similarity is measuring tag count, not meaning. Enable centering.
label_diag_hub_ref: Reference: |r| under 0.15 is measurement noise. With centering OFF the measured values were +0.32 to +0.53.
diag_group_ok: No bias from descriptive tags. Similarity is not driven by which analysis setting was used.
diag_group_warn: Media with descriptive tags match each other regardless of meaning. Turn off "Include descriptive tags in similarity".
diag_group_unmeasurable: Mixed analysis settings cannot be measured (needs both media with and without descriptive tags).
diag_scope: What is measured here is the raw model behaviour. It includes pairs that share tags, so the numbers come out higher than in similar-media search (which excludes candidates sharing tags).
diag_basis: These thresholds come from a small number of measurements — do not treat borderline values as exact.
label_spectrum_discard: Discard and rebuild vectors for the model in use
item_spectrum_discard_regen: You will need to rebuild them with "Vectorize missing tags"
item_spectrum_discard_note: Changing centering or descriptive-tag settings does not need a discard — change them and press "Measure similarity distribution" to see the effect immediately
spectrum_cleanup_vacuumed: The database file shrank as well.
spectrum_cleanup_not_vacuumed: The database file has not shrunk yet. The freed space will be reused the next time vectors are generated.
spectrum_cleanup_none: There were no vectors to delete.
spectrum_toggle_note: The two options below do not affect tag vectors. Toggle them and press "Measure similarity distribution" to compare immediately, without saving.
diag_dist_help:
The horizontal axis is similarity (−1 to +1); the vertical axis is how many pairs fell in each range. The center line marks 0.

With centering on, the shape should be a hill centered on 0. If everything piles into one bar, no pair can be told apart. A strong lean to the right means everything is being judged "similar".

Hover a bar to see its share.
diag_separation_help:
First, the basics: similarity is how close two media are in tag meaning, on a −1 to +1 scale. Every pair is measured.

sd (standard deviation) is a single number for how spread out those values are. sd 0.13 means a typical pair sits about 0.13 away from the average.

Closer to 0 means every pair has nearly the same value — nothing can be told apart. "Range" is the measured maximum minus the minimum.
diag_hub_help:
r (correlation coefficient) is a single number from −1 to +1 for how much two quantities move together. 0 means unrelated; +1 means one always rises with the other.

Here it compares how many tags a media has against its average similarity.

A large positive value means media with more tags match everything — similarity is measuring tag count rather than meaning, so heavily tagged photos dominate the results. Centering cancels this out.
diag_group_help:
Media are split into those with descriptive tags and those without. This compares the average similarity within each group against the average across groups.

The number shown is the within-group average minus the across-group average.

Near 0 means the split has no effect on similarity. A large value means media are matching because they were analyzed with the same setting, not because they mean similar things. The threshold is a quarter of sd.
diag_sample_help:
Checking every pair scales with the square of the count — even 1,000 media is about 500,000 pairs. So the calculation uses an evenly spaced sample.

The sample is picked the same way every time, so numbers do not jitter when you re-measure after changing a setting.

The two trailing numbers are the time to load vectors and compute centroids, and the time for the all-pairs comparison.
model_desc_vlm_translategemma_4b: For low-VRAM setups. Stays stable without hallucinating even on low-information images
model_desc_vlm_qwen3vl_8b: The reference model. Speed, accuracy and instruction-following all match larger models
model_desc_vlm_gemma4_12b: As accurate as qwen3-vl:8b-instruct but slower. An alternative when stability comes first
model_desc_emb_embeddinggemma: The lightest (768 dims). Matches or beats bge-m3 in separation and hub resistance
model_desc_emb_bge_m3: A light, easy multilingual model (1024 dims). Good enough to start with
model_desc_emb_qwen3_8b: Clearly better at separating concepts (4096 dims). Pick this if VRAM allows
model_desc_text_qwen35_9b: Assignment accuracy is high, but hypernym extraction is weak (measured 1-2/5). A compromise when VRAM is short
model_desc_text_gemma4_12b: Recommended. Hypernym extraction matched exactly 3 times out of 3, with zero invented tags. Faster and more accurate than larger models

download_done: The download finished and the model was set automatically.
label_preset_vlm: Recommended VLM presets (click to select / auto-download)
label_preset_text: Recommended text LLM presets (click to select / auto-download)
confirm_download_body: The Ollama model will be downloaded locally.
download_note_1: * Depending on your connection speed, the download can take several minutes.
download_note_2: * You can keep watching the progress in Settings or in the background while it downloads.

openai_base_url_help: URL of a server that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API.
api_key_help: Stored in the OS credential store. It is never written to the config file or the database.
